title: Affine functions from their coefficients
statement: Let $b\in\mathbb{F}_2$ and $a\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The algebraic normal form with constant coefficient $b$, singleton coefficient at $\{i\}$ equal to $a_i$, and all other coefficients zero evaluates at every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ to $b+\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$.
